# Badges

Static outline badges in the look of GitHub Copilot's severity badges, for comments and docs.
Text is glyph outlines (Mona Sans SemiBold), so they render the same everywhere. Each badge has a light and a dark SVG.
Generated by [`scripts/generate-badges/main.go`](../scripts/generate-badges/main.go); regenerate with `task generate:badges`.

## Use

URL pattern (`<mode>` is `light` or `dark`):

```text
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pyck-ai/.github/main/badges/<group>/<name>-<mode>.svg
```

Snippet (picks the SVG for the viewer's theme, falls back to light; `width` is the group's width below):

```html
<picture>
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: dark)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pyck-ai/.github/main/badges/severity/high-dark.svg">
  <source media="(prefers-color-scheme: light)" srcset="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pyck-ai/.github/main/badges/severity/high-light.svg">
  <img alt="High severity" src="https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pyck-ai/.github/main/badges/severity/high-light.svg" width="62" height="18" align="texttop">
</picture>
```

The raw URLs only resolve once the files are on `main`. The tables below use relative paths so the gallery renders on any branch.

## Confidence

`0` to `100` in 5% steps (round a value to the nearest step, for example 92% to `90`), coloured by value: an OKLCH gradient, red at 0%, orange at 50%, yellow at 70%, green from 85%. 85% and up is treated as sure, 50 to 85% as a suggestion. `rule` (blue) is a fixed rule check, not a model's guess; `ai` (grey) has no number.
